misty.editor.title: HUD editor
misty.editor.hint1: Drag a module to move it · Click to turn it on or off
misty.editor.hint2: Scroll to resize · Right-click to reset
misty.settings.title: Misty settings
misty.option.customMenu.tip: Replaces the Minecraft main menu with the Misty one.
misty.option.hud.tip: Shows the HUD modules in game (FPS, keystrokes, coordinates…).
misty.option.network.tip: The other Misty players see your Misty badge and cosmetics, and you see theirs. Off: nothing is sent and nothing is fetched.
misty.option.cosmetics.tip: Shows the Misty capes and elytra: yours, equipped in the launcher, and the other players'.
misty.wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
misty.wardrobe.subtitle: Click to equip, drag yourself to turn around.
misty.wardrobe.off: Misty cosmetics are turned off in the Misty settings.
